title: Smoked Polish Sausage with Juicy Gratin
description: A hearty and flavorful dish that combines the savory taste of smoked polish sausage with a rich and creamy gratin.
instructions: Cook the smoked polish sausage in a pan over medium-high heat until browned.
In a separate pan, sauté the onion, garlic, and jalapenos until softened.
Add the butter to the pan and stir until melted.
Pour in the cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the cheddar cheese and stir until melted and smooth.
Transfer the gratin to a baking dish and top with the cooked sausage.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped parsley if desired.
